title: Tablajeria R2 semantic extract readonly R5
objective: Re-leer semanticamente el resultado grande de auditoria de Tablajeria R2 usando el extractor ya corregido por R4. Si el source result no trae campos semanticos explicitos, emitir decision fail-closed completa: gate3_allowed=false, blocking_reason_if_any=SOURCE_SEMANTIC_FIELDS_MISSING, next_allowed_gate=GATE3_HOLD_PENDING_EXPLICIT_SEMANTIC_FIELDS. No mutar repositorio, SQL, Produccion, Scheduler, NetPay ni logica de Tablajeria.
hard_fail_conditions: Fail if source_result cannot be read from worker/results.
Fail if output lacks gate3_allowed, next_allowed_step, semantic_fields_complete, semantic_fields, source_semantic_fields_complete, or source_missing_semantic_fields.
Fail if gate3_allowed is inferred true from generic percent_complete, status, quality_gate, certification, or work_completion.
Gate3 remains HOLD unless output explicitly says gate3_allowed=true.
next_after_success: Use the emitted gate3_allowed and next_allowed_step values to decide whether Gate3 may be prepared. Do not open Gate3 automatically.
next_after_failure: Report exact blocker and keep Gate3 on HOLD.
